criteria.description: Exact project/Khronos audit, editable source reopen, two separate-PID queued semantic rebuilds, real transformed dimensions, contact and global exposure.

All eight separate final512px views personally inspected; required diagnostic features readable and globally exposed. Retain broad trilobed plates and small mostly-covered head, but correct generated collum that wrongly bears broad wings: small first collum has central shield only. Explicitly24 dorsalunits and44legpairs, seven-article antennae and eightpodomere shortlegs. Clubs not round cartoon eyes. Target juvenile39.8mm body, not scaled adult.

Twenty-four dorsal units: small collum without lateral paratergites, T2–23 each central arched syntergite plus two broad lateral wings, diminishing posteriorly, and terminal telson region. Forty-four pairs of short legs under plate edges: collum andT2 one pair each, T3–23 two pairs each; eight podomeres including terminal claw. Flattened head mostly beneath small collum, two seven-article ventrally originating antennae and two club-tipped ocular stalks; restrained ventral mouthpart outlines and low dorsal tubercles. Bounded to juvenile MNHN.F.SOT002123,39.8mm, from Montceau-les-Mines, unknown species. Not giant adult A.mammata, no2.6m extrapolation. Twenty-four dorsal units and44legpairs reconstructed by authors;38pairs preserved, missing positions in T12–14 inferred. Diet and terminalmouthpart articles uncertain; no forcipules. Antennae and stalkedocular outlines based on CT, no ommatidia invented.
Complete original frozen brief/config/reference/concept preserved; exact dependency closure, counts and real measurements.
Exact GLB successfully parsed through pinned Three.js GLTFLoader.
Actual device-renderer evidence required; CPU proof does not pass this stage.
Actual composed intended scene evidence required; unrun stays unknown.
